data.rationale: Three independent assessors support acceptance with disclosed risk after focused runtime evidence of majority routing, invalid assessment rejection, and Reviewer identity separation; acceptance is not automatic from the coverage percentage.
data.exceptions: Branch coverage, full repository regression, and historical archived-report compatibility were not run; first-round fixture failures remain in the record.
data.residual_risk: Unmeasured branches and unrun historical compatibility may hide defects. Independent Reviewer will statically inspect these paths and evidence consistency.
